title: Approvals say what they're for + Go pass (axHub #98)
asked: If chat can't reach hub and get all rules and updated threads then refuse to do anything until an approval on axhub. Change approval page: show what the approval is approving, when expanded what it's doing and a description, then a separate collapsible section with the code being executed

result.summary: axHub: reason required on calls needing approval, page layers, Go pass to the go-pass branch (400 tests). AXHub web app: approval title/what it does/collapsible code, Go pass page (174 checks). Console callers send reasons; shared rule + Project instructions.
